acceptanceCriteria: A neutral member name replaces the legacy adopter-named member in a new behavior provider version; /1 bytes stay pinned by TestAFUV1BehaviorProviderV1BytesUnchanged.
The legacy member appears only in the /1 decoder and its frozen fixture, and the specs name it only as 'the legacy /1 member'.
A decode test proves /1 producers still load and the new version emits only the neutral member.
body: Follow-up from V1-0977 (2026-10-07, branch claude/v1-0977-adopter-name-redaction, commit 50dbd59b). The doccorpus behavior provider /1 encodes one JSON member whose name is a private adopter's product name (internal/doccorpus/behavior.go). Renaming it breaks the frozen /1 bytes (AFU-V1-006, TestAFUV1BehaviorProviderV1BytesUnchanged), so V1-0977 kept it. Coordinator decision: never break /1; introduce a neutral member in the next provider version and confine the legacy string to the /1 decode path and specs' legacy note. Do not write the adopter's name in tickets, commits or logs. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks build 202.
